:cache.description: Number of rows rendered in advance to boost the performance
:cache.description_zh: 提前渲染的行数，用于提高性能

:estimated-row-height.description: The estimated row height for rendering dynamic height rows
:estimated-row-height.description_zh: 用于渲染动态高度行的估计行高

header-class.description: Customized class name passed to header wrapper
header-class.description_zh: 传递给头部包装器的自定义类名

:header-props.description: Customized props name passed to header component
:header-props.description_zh: 传递给头部组件的自定义 props

:header-cell-props.description: Customized props name passed to header cell component
:header-cell-props.description_zh: 传递给头部单元格组件的自定义 props

:header-height.description: The height of the header is set by `height`. If given an array, it renders header rows equal to its length
:header-height.description_zh: 表头的高度，由 `height` 设置。如果给定一个数组，则渲染的表头行数等于其长度

:footer-height.description: The height of the footer element, when provided, will be part to the calculation of the table's height
:footer-height.description_zh: 页脚元素的高度，提供后，将成为表格高度计算的一部分

row-class.description: Customized class name passed to row wrapper
row-class.description_zh: 传递给行包装器的自定义类名

row-key.description: The key of each row, if not provided, will be the index of the row
row-key.description_zh: 每一行的唯一标识，如果未提供，则为行的索引

:row-props.description: Customized props name passed to row component
:row-props.description_zh: 传递给行组件的自定义 props

:row-height.description: The height of each row, used for calculating the total height of the table
:row-height.description_zh: 每行的高度，用于计算表格的总高度

:cell-props.description: Extra props passed to each cell (except header cells)
:cell-props.description_zh: 传递给每个单元格的额外 props（表头单元格除外）

:data.description: An array of data to be rendered in the table
:data.description_zh: 表格中要渲染的数据数组

:data-getter.description: A method to customize data fetch from the data source
:data-getter.description_zh: 自定义从数据源获取数据的方法

:fixed-data.description: Data for rendering rows above the main content and below the header
:fixed-data.description_zh: 用于在主内容上方和表头下方渲染行的数据

expand-column-key.description: The column key indicates which row is expandable
expand-column-key.description_zh: 指示哪一行可展开的列键

:expanded-row-keys.description: An array of keys for expanded rows, can be used with `v-model`
:expanded-row-keys.description_zh: 展开行的键数组，可与 `v-model` 一起使用

:default-expanded-row-keys.description: An array of keys for default expanded rows, **NON REACTIVE**
:default-expanded-row-keys.description_zh: 默认展开行的键数组，**非响应式**

class.description: Class name for the virtual table, will be applied to all three tables (left, right, main)
class.description_zh: 虚拟表的类名，将应用于所有三个表（左、右、主）

fixed.description: Flag indicates the table column's width to be fixed or flexible
fixed.description_zh: 指示表列宽度是固定还是灵活的标志

:h-scrollbar-size.description: Indicates the horizontal scrollbar's size for the table, used to prevent the horizontal and vertical scrollbar to collapse
:h-scrollbar-size.description_zh: 表格的水平滚动条大小，用于防止水平和垂直滚动条重叠

:v-scrollbar-size.description: Indicates the vertical scrollbar's size for the table, used to prevent the horizontal and vertical scrollbar to collapse
:v-scrollbar-size.description_zh: 表格的垂直滚动条大小，用于防止水平和垂直滚动条重叠

scrollbar-always-on.description: If true, the scrollbar will always be shown instead of when mouse is placed above the table
scrollbar-always-on.description_zh: 如果为 true，滚动条将始终显示，而不是当鼠标放在表格上方时显示

events.name: expanded-rows-change
events.description_zh: 当展开的行更改时调用

events.name: end-reached
events.description: Invoked when the end of the table is reached
events.description_zh: 当达到表格末尾时调用

events.name: row-expand
events.description: Invoked when expand/collapse the tree node by clicking the arrow icon
events.description_zh: 当通过点击箭头图标展开/折叠树节点时调用

events.name: row-event-handlers
events.description: A collection of handlers attached to each row
events.description_zh: 附加到每一行的处理程序集合

methods.name: scrollToLeft
methods.description: Scroll to a given horizontal position

methods.name: scrollToTop
methods.description: Scroll to a given vertical position

methods.name: scrollToRow
methods.description: Scroll to a given row with specified scroll strategy
methods.description_zh: 使用指定的滚动策略滚动到指定行

slots.name: header-cell
slots.description_zh: 自定义表头单元格内容

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Custom empty content when no data is available
slots.description_zh: 没有数据时的自定义空内容

typeDetail.HeaderClassGetter: Function that returns the class for a header
typeDetail.HeaderPropsGetter: Function that returns props for a header
typeDetail.HeaderCellPropsGetter: Function that returns props for a header cell
typeDetail.RowClassGetter: Function that returns the class for a row
typeDetail.RowPropsGetter: Function that returns props for a row
typeDetail.CellPropsGetter: Function that returns props for a cell
typeDetail.DataGetter: Function that retrieves data from the data source
